# SiteLift — WordPress-exit website migrations (Toledo Technologies)

Get off WordPress without losing your SEO, your content, or your weekends. SiteLift moves your
site to a fast, secure, low-maintenance stack — you keep your rankings and own every account.
By Toledo Technologies, a Connecticut web studio run by Nicholas Toledo. Serves Connecticut
businesses in person and clients nationwide remotely.

Contact: hello@toledotechnologies.com · https://sitelift.toledotechnologies.com

## What it is
- A productized WordPress-exit migration. Fixed scope, fixed price, no surprises.
- Arcadia (simple 3–7 page sites) from $3,500. Aegis (standard small-business migration) ~$9,500.
- SEO preserved (redirects mapped), content + media migrated, hosting ~$20/mo, you own all accounts.

## Good fit
Small businesses tired of WordPress updates, plugin bloat, security scares, and slow hosting —
who want a fast, accessible site and a developer who ships instead of sending status updates.
